keyEvents.text: Josh Laurent (Burnley) is shown the yellow card.
Jayden Meghoma (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Ebou Adams replaces Adrian Segecic.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Tyrese Shade replaces Ryan Kavuma-McQueen.
Substitution, Burnley. Jaydon Banel replaces Jamie Vardy.
Substitution, Burnley. Josh Cullen replaces Reo Hatate.
Substitution, Burnley. Aaron Ramsey replaces Andréas Hountondji.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Josh Murphy replaces Marezi.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Terry Devlin replaces Jayden Meghoma.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Thomas Waddingham replaces Abu Kamara.
Substitution, Burnley. Oliver Sonne replaces Marcus Edwards.
